name: Generate Model Documentation
description: Generates comprehensive Markdown documentation for a model test result. Uses LLM to create human-readable analysis and recommendations based on test scores and capabilities.

inputs.name: Document
inputs.description: The Knowledge Base document envelope containing model test results

inputs.name: Collection
inputs.description: The collection this document belongs to

inputs.name: Template Path
inputs.description: Path to the Handlebars template for documentation generation

outputs.name: Documentation Path
outputs.description: Path to the generated Markdown documentation

outputs.name: Analysis
outputs.description: LLM-generated analysis of the model capabilities

prompt.system: You are a technical documentation expert specializing in AI model capabilities. Generate clear, actionable documentation that helps developers understand what a model can and cannot do.

metadata.author: Maestro Team
metadata.overrideInstructions: Clone this block to customize the documentation template, modify the LLM prompt, or change the output format.
